name: japanese-speaking
description: Write Japanese that sounds like people talking, not reading lines, for podcast and radio dialogue, a news item one host reads and both discuss, interviews, narration, and talk scripts, checked by a script and a fresh reader before you use it

interface.longDescription: Writes Japanese meant to be heard: a podcast or radio dialogue between hosts, a news item one host reads and both then discuss, an interview, a narration, or a talk script. It lays out who says what before writing, writes in the polite spoken Japanese of a radio host, and passes on what sources say as reported instead of stating it as fact. A script reports lines that sound read from paper, such as a sentence that stops on a particle, a question without ka, one host quizzing another like an expert, casual contractions, written-style endings, and a source stated as fact, along with numbers and names the material does not have. A fresh reader then listens for lines that still sound read, and the agent fixes both. It adds no facts and never sends anything.
defaultPrompt: Write a two-host podcast script from this article
